item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.25

  • Clipboard history in the Tray: the last 25 things you copied, one click from being copied again. It's off until you turn it on, it stays on your Mac, and passwords from password managers are skipped.
  • Settings → Permissions shows everything ShawNotch may use (camera, calendars, Spotify, your music's sound, Downloads), with a button to allow or change each one.
  • Settings → Help has Request a Feature and Report a Problem, and opening ShawNotch again while it's running shows Settings.
